mobile-lifecycle.name: Mobile application lifecycle
mobile-lifecycle.description: Handle screen transitions, process recreation, foreground work, and background execution.

mobile-state.name: Mobile state management
mobile-state.description: Keep application state consistent across navigation, asynchronous work, and lifecycle changes.

mobile-networking.name: Mobile networking
mobile-networking.description: Integrate remote APIs with timeouts, retries, connectivity awareness, and response validation.

mobile-persistence.name: Mobile data persistence
mobile-persistence.description: Store application data locally with migration, concurrency, and retention controls.

offline-synchronization.name: Offline synchronization
offline-synchronization.description: Resolve local and remote changes through queued writes, conflict handling, and synchronization policies.

mobile-accessibility.name: Mobile accessibility
mobile-accessibility.description: Support assistive technologies, scalable text, clear focus order, and accessible touch targets.

push-notifications.name: Push notifications
push-notifications.description: Manage device registration, notification permissions, delivery handling, and deep links.

mobile-performance.name: Mobile performance optimization
mobile-performance.description: Profile launch time, rendering, memory use, battery impact, and network activity.

native-integration.name: Native platform integration
native-integration.description: Bridge shared application code to platform-specific services and device capabilities.

mobile-security.name: Mobile application security
mobile-security.description: Protect credentials, device storage, platform permissions, and application communication.

mobile-testing.name: Mobile application testing
mobile-testing.description: Verify device behavior, lifecycle changes, accessibility, and supported operating-system versions.

mobile-release.name: Mobile release management
mobile-release.description: Manage signing, store submissions, staged releases, and production crash monitoring.

mobile-architecture.name: Mobile application architecture
mobile-architecture.description: Separate interface, domain, and data responsibilities with testable dependency boundaries.
